entries.title: GitHub merges wait for checks still being created
entries.body: A pull request no longer reads ready to merge while GitHub is still running its checks, including the moment before a later check shows up.
entries.noPicture: This changes when a merge is allowed, not the appearance of a view.

exclusions.reason: Internal CI work: pick journeys on hosted Linux and skip the Mac runner when no files are selected; preserve the Linux jobs and all-checks gate.
